authoring.author: claude (kinkerstraat even-side faces lane)
authoring.note: Kinkerstraat 110-86 (even side, 1893), 2024-11-29 strip in late sun. One row of kinker-1890-plain-brick fronts, 3 axes on ~5 m, heavy consoled cornice at ~14.2 m (strip rows 271-283; 3DBAG 16.9-17.1 m reads the mansards), one pediment dormer per house. Three head variants read on the zoomed strip: a dotted white block course at the window heads (110-100, bands: painted head line 0.3 m; pass 1 tried windowSurround stone-lintel, a thin grey slab invisible at gallery size), white keystones on flat brick heads (98, 96, 92), segmental heads with ornamented tympana on storeys 1-2 (94, 90, 86-88). Shops read on the strip; the pand-reference crops are other dates (2018-2025) and only confirm layout.
